maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly management fees from managed REITs and private capital vehicles, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Fees come from REITs and private investors; tenants and clients are mostly private businesses, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by managing more REITs and private capital strategies and fee growth, not through a steady stream of acquired companies.

mission_critical.reason: Long-term external management contracts with affiliated REITs plus integrated property management make replacing the manager costly and complex.

notes: Mission-critical rests on management contracts with affiliated REITs; it is a judgement call.
